description: Compare four image models on the same brief. Run makes four paid images. Judge the exact heading and footer, object count, tool shapes, composition and color. Change the shared brief to test your o… text:Shared test brief -> image:Contender 1 -> image:Contender 2 -> image:Contender 3 -> image:Contender 4; returns image (muse-image/text-to-image, 1:1) + image (gpt-image-2.5/flare/text-to-image, 1k) + image (grok-imagine-image/v2.0/text-to-image, 1:1) + image (recraft-v4, 1024×1024) saved to disk (file paths in result). Runs on NanoGPT — $0.40 deposit per call, paid in Nano (XNO) — settles at actual model cost + 20%, change returned; no account needed; last run $0.264, ~73s. Example: Reviewed sample (https://nanoodle.com/examples/gallery/#image-model-arena). The same bicycle-repair poster brief sent to four image models. All four retained the requested text in this run; only Grok rendered recognizable tire levers. Compare all outputs before choosing. It can also be paid in NEAR: add "_pay_with": "near" for a NEAR quote, send the exact amount in one transfer, then call again with the same arguments plus _payment_id, _payment_tx and _payment_sender.

Shared_test_brief.description: Text; default: "Create a square poster for a bicycle repair workshop. Exact heading: FIX A FLAT. Exact footer: SATURDAY 10 AM. A sing..."; optional

_pay_with.description: Payment rail for the quote: "nano" (default, XNO over x402), "near" (native NEAR) or "usdc" (Circle-issued USDC on NEAR).

_payment_id.description: Payment id from this tool's previous payment-required response. Phase 3 only: after /x402/watch closes with status paid, call again with the same arguments plus this id to open the RESULTS stream. Do not pass it while payment is still pending — monitor the watch SSE first.

_payment_sender.description: The NEAR account you paid from. It locates the transaction; the refund goes to the transaction's signer.

_payment_tx.description: Hash (base58) of the exact quoted payment: one native Transfer for NEAR, or one ft_transfer on the quoted token contract for USDC.
